as_of_note: US closes Wed 25 Nov 2026 (pre-Thanksgiving): huge intraday reversal. At the lows S&P -3.2%, Nasdaq -4.6%, Dow -1,100+ pts (-2.2%); Nasdaq 100 touched exactly -20% from its Oct peak (Dow Jones Market Data via MarketWatch). Close: S&P 500 -0.25% to 7,182.78; Nasdaq -0.62% to 23,585.80; Dow +164.25 (+0.33%) to 50,182.95; RUT +0.7% to 2,704.06 (Kitco). Triggers: USTR proposed Section 301 'excess capacity' tariffs on 14 economies incl. Singapore (up to 20%), China (up to 20%), EU/Japan/Taiwan/Switzerland (15%); Oct core PCE 3.3% y/y vs 3.2% est (headline 3.8%); Q3 GDP revised to 4.3% from 3.4%; claims 189k. Rebound helped by WSJ report of no evidence China directed the Huang affair and Burry saying he is 'almost entirely long'. NVDA -3.91% to $149.30; S&P put NVDA's AA on CreditWatch Negative. VIX 28.29 (+7.32%). 10Y 4.85% / 2Y 4.61% (Treasury par). DXY 104.00 (+0.18%). WTI $83.68 (+1.99%), Brent Jan $94.61 (+3.51%) after Houthis claimed an attack on Saudi Ras Tanura. Gold spot ~$3,576 (+0.6%) late after a dip below $3,450. FedWatch: 97.8% for a 25bp hike on 9 Dec. US markets closed Thu 26 Nov; NYSE early close 1 PM ET Fri 27 Nov (2 AM Sat SGT).
